notes: Copy to config/data-sources.json (gitignored) and edit. The test console (test-console/console/server.ts --data-config) re-reads it on every call, so edits need no restart. The page can browse and read ONLY inside allowedRoots (links leading out are refused); it starts in defaultFolder. defaultMode 'whole' sends every file in the folder with each question (re-read at each Send); 'pick' starts with file checkboxes. Keep data folders outside every git repository, outside OneDrive or other sync tools, and outside the Claude filesystem connector's allowed folders. extensions: the file types listed and loaded (PDF text is extracted in the browser). maxBytes: per extension, '*' for the rest. exclude: file name patterns (* and ?) to hide. maxFiles: most files listed per folder. hideFolders: folder-name patterns never listed (the analyst keeps its recipes and run manifests in _analyst under the first allowed root). Nothing is ever written or created.
